$comment: Schema-like description of ONE timing record (spec section 19, section 12.4). One JSON object per line in a ledger file. Types are JSON types; 'enum' lists the allowed values.
title: canon benchmark ledger record

instance_id.description: Stable identifier of the instance (family, parameters, seed).

family.description: Benchmark family of spec section 19, e.g. sparse-regular, grid-subset, tensor-monomial.

N.description: Number of base vertices including any auxiliaries (N = n for profile P1).

m.description: Input size parameter: arcs/tuples/stored references as defined for the family.

objective.description: Objective tag, spec section 3 (1 = CANONICAL_IMAGE ... 9 = CONSTRAINT_ENUM).

mode.description: Setup cost accounting: cold includes group build/verification, warm reuses them, amortised divides over a batch.

T_seconds.description: Measured end-to-end time, including import, group build, output.

L_seconds.description: The stated lower bound in seconds.

bound_category.description: U problem/contract, A specified-algorithm work, H hardware model, E calibrated engineering estimate (never a lower bound).

bound_equation.description: The equation or reference (e.g. docs/performance-lower-bounds.md section) that produced L.

censored.description: True if the run hit a time/memory limit; T_seconds is then a lower bound on the true time. Censored cases are kept, never dropped.
